conv.elsewhere: This chat runs on {{computer}}. Show that computer in the top bar to read it here.
conv.unavailable: This chat can't be read here right now.
slash.compact: Summarise the earlier messages to free up room
slash.desc.clear: Start this chat over with an empty conversation
slash.clear.title: Clear this conversation?
slash.clear.body: Every message of this chat is cleared, for the agent too. This cannot be undone.
slash.clear.wait: /clear waits until the agent's reply ends. Nothing was sent.
slash.clear.files: Remove the attached files first: /clear sends nothing else. Nothing was sent.
slash.clear.unknown: It is not known whether the conversation was cleared. Check the chat.
slash.memoryNote: /memory {{what}} runs on the Memory page. Nothing was sent.
slash.desc.skills: List the skills this chat can use
slash.desc.hooks: Show this chat's hooks; add reload to read them again
slash.desc.memory: Show what the agent remembers for this folder
slash.terminalNote: /{{name}} works only in the terminal app for now. Nothing was sent.
slash.fork.usage: Type /fork to fork the whole chat, or /fork and the number of a finished turn, as in /fork 3. Nothing was sent.
slash.trim.usage: Type /trim and the number of the finished turn to keep through, as in /trim 3: what follows it is removed. Nothing was sent.
slash.turn.none: This chat has no finished turn {{n}}. Nothing was sent.
slash.turn.unavailable: This chat does not offer that here. Nothing was sent.
conv.cap.chatText: Answers here. Its agent has no tools: it can't read files or run commands on {{computer}}.
slash.copy.usage: Type /copy to copy the last reply, or /copy and the number of a finished turn, as in /copy 3. Nothing was sent.
slash.copy.doneLast: The last reply is copied. Nothing was sent.
slash.copy.done: The reply of turn {{n}} is copied. Nothing was sent.
slash.copy.none: This chat has no finished turn {{n}}. Nothing was copied or sent.
slash.copy.empty: This chat has no finished reply yet. Nothing was copied or sent.
slash.copy.failed: The browser did not allow the copy. Use Copy under the reply. Nothing was sent.
conv.aat.label: Approve actions for this reply
conv.aat.desc: The agent's own approvals in this reply are answered yes. Helpers still ask.
conv.aat.why.approval_unknown: The approval mode could not be read.
conv.aat.why.later: Works only for a new reply, when the chat is idle.
conv.aat.why.other: Not available for this chat now.
conv.aat.why.send: Works once this message can be sent.
conv.send.unknown: This message may already have been sent. Check the chat before you send it again.
conv.send.dismissed: If it went through, it will show in the chat.
conv.stop.unknown: Stop may have gone through. The chat shows when the turn ends.
conv.send.held: Check the chat first: your last message may already have been sent
conv.send.unresolved: An earlier message to this chat is still unresolved. Check it first.
conv.att.imgBig: {{name}} is {{size}}. Images can be up to 4 MB, and this one couldn't be made smaller to fit.
conv.att.imgMany: {{name}} wasn't added: up to 4 images go with one message.
conv.att.bodyFull: {{name}} wasn't added: the message would be too big to send (about 7.5 MB in all).
conv.att.textBig: {{name}} is {{size}}. Text files up to 24 KB go into the message; for a bigger one, tell your agent where it is on the computer, or put it there with Files.
conv.att.notText: {{name}} isn't an image or a text file.
conv.att.textMany: {{name}} wasn't added: up to 3 text files go with one message.
conv.att.textFull: {{name}} wasn't added: the message with its text files would pass 28 KB.
conv.att.skipped: {{name}} wasn't read: up to 10 files at a time.
conv.att.imgBroken: {{name}} looks like an image but can't be read as one, so it wasn't added.
conv.att.tooLong: The message with its files is too big to send. Remove a file or shorten the text.
conv.att.reading: Reading your files. Send waits until they're added.
conv.gate.waits: Your agent reads this after you answer the waiting approval. To decline it, use Deny.
conv.gate.queued: Queued. Your agent reads your message after you answer the request.
conv.gate.queuedQuestion: Queued. Your agent reads your message after you answer its question.
conv.gate.waitsQuestion: Your agent reads this after you answer its question.
conv.queued.hint: Images can't join a reply that is already running. Send queues this message for when the reply ends.
conv.queued.hintGate: Images can't join a reply that is already running. Send queues this message for when you have answered and the reply ends.
conv.queued.on: Queued. Sends when this reply ends, while this chat stays open. You can still change it.
conv.queued.onGate: Queued. Sends after you answer and the reply ends, while this chat stays open.
conv.queued.sendWhy: Already queued: it sends when this reply ends
conv.queued.left: Your queued message was not sent: this chat was left before the reply ended. Its text is still here. Add its files again to send it.
conv.queued.kept: The reply ended, but your queued message was not sent. It is still here.
conv.queued.gone: Your queued message was not sent: this chat could not be shown for a moment. Its text is still here. Add its files again to send it.
conv.queued.no.command: Commands aren't sent automatically. Press Send.
conv.queued.no.empty: It has no text. Type a message to send with the files.
conv.queued.no.long: It is too long. Shorten the text.
conv.add.computer.desc: Attach files that are on any of your computers
conv.add.computer.title: Attach files from a computer
conv.add.computer.note: Each file is read once and added to this message; nothing is sent yet. Images up to {{img}} and up to {{texts}} text files of {{text}} each can be attached.
conv.add.computer.why.folder: {{name}} is a folder now. Choose a file in it.
conv.add.computer.why.missing: {{name}} isn't in that folder any more.
conv.add.computer.why.big: {{name}} is {{size}}. Files up to {{max}} can be read from a computer.
conv.add.computer.why.bigRow: Over {{max}}: too large to read from a computer. Mention it instead.
conv.add.computer.why.textBig: Over {{max}}: too large to attach as text. Mention it instead.
conv.add.mention.desc: Write a file's path into the message, from any computer
conv.add.mention.title: Mention a file
conv.add.mention.note: The file's path is written into your message and nothing is read now. A file on another computer is written with that computer's name.
conv.add.notes.desc: Attach the text of your notes
conv.add.notes.full: This message already has {{max}} text files. Remove one to attach a note.
conv.add.notes.title: Attach notes
conv.add.notes.body_one: Pick a note. Its text is attached as a text file, up to {{max}} of text. Nothing is sent yet.
conv.add.notes.body_other: Pick up to {{count}} notes. Each note's text is attached as a text file, up to {{max}} of text a note. Nothing is sent yet.
conv.add.notes.col.title: Title
conv.add.notes.empty: There are no recent notes on your running computers.
conv.add.notes.tooLongWhy: This note is longer than {{max}} of text, so it can't be attached.
conv.add.notes.long: Nothing was attached. Longer than {{max}} of text, so it can't be attached: {{names}}.
conv.add.notes.over_one: This message has room for {{count}} more text file.
conv.add.notes.over_other: This message has room for {{count}} more text files.
conv.add.notes.unread_one: The notes of {{count}} running computer couldn't be read.
conv.add.notes.unread_other: The notes of {{count}} running computers couldn't be read.
conv.add.notes.failed: A note couldn't be read, so nothing was attached.
conv.add.url.desc: Attach a web page, as Markdown or as it is
conv.add.url.noComputer: Open this chat's computer to read a web page from it.
conv.add.url.title: Attach a web page
conv.add.url.body: The page is read on this chat's computer, not by the Hub, and added to your message as a file. Nothing is sent yet.
conv.add.url.bad.empty: Enter a web address, for example https://example.com/article.
conv.add.url.bad.scheme: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.
conv.add.url.bad.local: This address can't be opened from here. Use a public web address, not a local or private one.
conv.add.url.markdown.desc: The page's main text, cleaned up by a hidden browser on this computer. Best for articles and docs.
conv.add.url.asis.desc: The file exactly as the site sends it: HTML, JSON, plain text or an image. Text up to {{max}}.
conv.add.url.long: This page is longer than {{max}} of text, the most one message file holds. You can attach the first {{max}}; the rest is left out.
conv.add.url.cutNote: [The rest of this page was left out: only the first {{max}} fit in the message.]
conv.add.url.status: The site answered with error {{status}}, so nothing was attached. Check the address.
conv.add.url.notText: This address gives a file that is neither text nor an image, so it can't be attached.
conv.add.url.tooBig: This page is too large to read, so nothing was attached.
conv.add.url.starting: This may have gone through: the page reader on this computer may still be starting. Check again in a moment.
conv.add.url.redirected: This address sends you on to a local or private address, or too many times, so nothing was attached.
conv.add.url.failed: The address couldn't be read from your computer, so nothing was attached.
conv.add.url.failedMd: This computer couldn't read this page as Markdown, so nothing was attached. Try As it is.
